title: FCL Samples
description: Gallery and resolver index for FCL sample models.

candle-holder.name: Geometric Wireframe Candle Holder
candle-holder.description: A multi-tiered geometric wireframe lantern with a central resting candle dish.
candle-holder.markdown: Constructed from layered hexagonal wire chords and diagonal lattice struts across four Z-levels (Z0 through Z3)[cite: 1]. Utilizes polar trigonometric functions (`@CosDeg`, `@SinDeg`) and index-driven rotational stepping (`$index`) to build a symmetrical wireframe structure.

cutlery-basket.name: Parametric Cutlery Caddy
cutlery-basket.description: A wooden cutlery organizer featuring curved top profiles, internal compartment dividers, and an integrated dowel handle.
cutlery-basket.markdown: Demonstrates subtractive circular profile extrusions to generate smooth top dips across outer walls and central dividers[cite: 2]. Integrates indexed array placement (`qty=2`, `$index`) for front dividers and combines solid side arms with a top cylindrical dowel handle.

pen-stand.name: Triad Hexagonal Pen Stand
pen-stand.description: A 3-column desk organizer with flat-to-flat touching hexagonal cups on a thick base plate.
pen-stand.markdown: Calculates exact center-to-center packing distances (`R_tri`, `D`) for non-interfering flat-to-flat hexagonal contact[cite: 3]. Features 30° rotated outer/inner hexagon sketch profiles extruded to varied column heights (120mm, 85mm, 55mm).

phone-stand.name: Desktop Phone Stand
phone-stand.description: An angled desktop smartphone stand with filleted corners and integrated cable clearance holes.
phone-stand.markdown: Constructs an angled phone support consisting of a main backrest, front shelf, and rear leg. Uses sketch fillet radii (`filletradius`), cable clearance cutouts, and angular X-axis rotations (`.rx`) to position support members flush to the desk plane.
